# Purpose

Generate a complete Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).

# Input

spec.md
Acceptance Criteria
Business Rules

# Output

Generate traceability.md

The AI should:

Map every requirement to:
Business Rule
Validation Rule
Acceptance Criteria
Test Case(s)
Identify:
Missing mappings
Uncovered requirements
Duplicate requirements
Produce a Markdown table with Requirement ID, Description, Related Rules, Test Cases, and Coverage Status.
